name: 24K Magic AI: Dance on the Cruise Ship Deck Like Dracula
blurb: The 24K Magic AI trend turns the Dracula deck dance from Hotel Transylvania 3 into a live-action video with your own face: you tug your collar, then dance alone on a sunny cruise ship deck to "24K Magic".

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same sunny cruise ship deck, the same camera angles, cuts, timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the young man who dances is now the person in [Image 1].

The dancer = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The dancer wears the clothes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, add the rest so it matches, with dark trousers and dark shoes. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends recognize them at once, also in the wide shots and during kicks and spins. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancer's face. NO short light-brown hair and NO dark grey T-shirt unless [Image 1] shows them. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the dancer is that animal standing upright, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

The shots, matching [Video 1] second by second:
Shot 1 [0-2.1s]: indoor close-up in a warm wood-paneled cabin doorway: the dancer looks into the camera with a proud grin and tugs the collar of the shirt with both hands.
Shot 2 [2.1-3.8s]: hard cut, a wide shot of the open wooden deck of a cruise ship on a sunny afternoon, white railing, blue sea and sky: the dancer, small in the frame, starts to dance.
Shot 3 [3.8-5.7s]: hard cut, a low close-up of the dancer's legs and dark shoes sliding, kicking and stepping on the deck boards.
Shot 4 [5.7-10.2s]: hard cut, a medium-wide shot in front of white deck stairs: the dancer does loose leg kicks, knee drops, arm swings and a deep lunge, on the beat, fully committed.

The dancer copies every move of the original dancer at the same moment, in the same direction and at the same speed. Real live-action footage, clear facial features.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the dancer's shoulders. A face never appears on knees, legs, hands or clothes. Two arms, two legs. Exactly one person in every shot. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same sunny cruise ship deck, the same camera angles, cuts, timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the young man who dances is now the pet in [Image 1], standing upright on its hind legs and dancing like him.

The dancer = the pet in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: the same species and breed, face, eyes, ears, muzzle, fur colors, fur length and markings as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything. It stays that animal, with animal paws, never human hands, never a human face. The same pet in every frame, from the first second to the last, so its owner recognizes it at once. No person appears at all: never drift back to the original dancer.

The shots, matching [Video 1] second by second:
Shot 1 [0-2.1s]: indoor close-up in a warm wood-paneled cabin doorway: the pet looks into the camera, proud, and tugs at its own chest fur with both front paws.
Shot 2 [2.1-3.8s]: hard cut, a wide shot of the open wooden deck of a cruise ship on a sunny afternoon, white railing, blue sea and sky: the pet, small in the frame, starts to dance on its hind legs.
Shot 3 [3.8-5.7s]: hard cut, a low close-up of the pet's hind paws sliding, kicking and stepping on the deck boards.
Shot 4 [5.7-10.2s]: hard cut, a medium-wide shot in front of white deck stairs: the pet does loose kicks, knee drops, front-paw swings and a deep lunge, on the beat.

Real live-action footage, a real animal. Anatomy rules: one head only, one muzzle, four legs, no extra animals, no people. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
